description: You want adventure? You want a princess? You're not getting the princess, buddy... but Adventure Awaits in "Overworld"! How much adventure? A statistically significant amount. Somewhere in the neighborhood of 18ppm... (or roughly 18 milligrams per liter... the density of adventure is unusually high, and in some cases even at 18ppm you will get a weight closer to 19mg/L.) Download comes with a faster version, a SUPER faster version, and a slower version without percussion for lazy title screens and whatnot.
